candidates.headline: Copilot code review adds tool-backed verification and an agent ensemble

score.rationale: Fresh primary release with a concrete harness pattern and specific vendor experiment results, qualified as non-independent evidence.

candidates.selection_rationale: Best current technical story on tool-backed verification, ensemble review, and visible failure handling.

candidates.headline: GitHub separates VS Code agent activity from generic Copilot usage

score.rationale: Primary documentation defines observability boundaries, access policy, time windows, and unavailable-data semantics.

candidates.selection_rationale: Pairs agent telemetry with a strong warning against treating activity as quality or value.

candidates.headline: Gemini for Windows brings a keyboard-first AI layer to desktop work

score.rationale: Broad-access official release with immediate knowledge-worker relevance and clear context-boundary implications.

candidates.selection_rationale: Strongest current desktop-workflow item after availability and capability verification.

candidates.headline: Cross-platform grounding is the hidden requirement for workplace AI

score.rationale: Fresh vendor analysis makes silent retrieval incompleteness concrete, but does not offer independent comparative accuracy results.

candidates.selection_rationale: Selected for a high-value grounding and provenance lesson with evidence limitations stated.

candidates.headline: Mastra moves reusable Agent Skills into shared filesystem workspaces

score.rationale: Official release materially extends reusable skills into shared stores, retrieval, mounts, and sandbox boundaries.

novelty_check.what_changed: Mastra adds shared and remotely mounted skill stores with on-demand search and a separate sandbox requirement for scripts.

candidates.selection_rationale: Selected as the edition’s exactly one reusable Agent Skills story and a material update to yesterday’s portability coverage.

candidates.headline: A hands-on no-code agent comparison shows that fit depends on the whole workflow

score.rationale: Hands-on configuration evidence is useful, though mixed with vendor documentation and older table timestamps.

candidates.selection_rationale: Selected for immediate non-technical evaluation value across debugging, failure handling, hosting, and cost.

candidates.headline: RubyGems account compromise renews interest in agent-era package controls

score.rationale: Potentially important supply-chain incident, but the discovery did not yield a direct affected-party disclosure or sufficiently specific canonical report URL.

candidates.rejection_reason: Rejected because original incident evidence and a stable direct article identity were not verified.

candidates.headline: Oracle lists Grok 4.6 for on-demand generative AI inference

score.rationale: Primary availability evidence is strong, but the item offers limited new reliability or workflow insight.

candidates.rejection_reason: Rejected as a routine model-availability update with lower practical differentiation.

candidates.headline: Mastra adds keyword and semantic search across workspace filesystems

score.rationale: Useful retrieval feature, but it is tightly coupled to the selected filesystem-skills development.

novelty_check.what_changed: Adds BM25, vector, or hybrid retrieval over mounted workspace content.

candidates.rejection_reason: Rejected as overlapping evidence for the selected Mastra story rather than an independent development.

candidates.headline: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash claims faster agentic inference

score.rationale: The topic appeared in discovery and video metadata, but an exact primary model card or release artifact was not verified.

candidates.rejection_reason: Rejected because the precise primary release evidence needed for performance claims was unavailable.

candidates.headline: Google AlphaGenome Atlas predicts variant effects at population scale

score.rationale: Substantive science development with official evidence, but it is predictive biology rather than the brief’s generative-AI focus.

candidates.rejection_reason: Rejected as outside the standing generative-AI and agent workflow focus.

candidates.headline: Google WeatherNext 3 expands global forecasting availability

score.rationale: Important forecasting update but outside the brief’s core generative-AI and knowledge-work scope.

candidates.rejection_reason: Rejected for category mismatch despite scientific significance.

candidates.headline: Google demonstrates AI-assisted recreation of an unrecorded family history

score.rationale: Interesting creative case, but promotional framing and limited transferable operating evidence reduce utility.

candidates.rejection_reason: Rejected in favor of developments with clearer repeatable work and control patterns.

candidates.headline: Salesforce reports gains from redesigned AI-assisted work

score.rationale: Potentially useful adoption evidence, but discovery surfaced promotional and self-reported claims without an independent study artifact.

candidates.rejection_reason: Rejected because evidence quality and independent verification were insufficient.

candidates.headline: GitHub’s weekly Copilot bundle consolidates recent agent and review changes

score.rationale: Strong official bundle but overlaps both selected GitHub items and previous daily coverage.

novelty_check.what_changed: The weekly bundle consolidates newer review and session changes.

candidates.rejection_reason: Rejected to avoid double-counting individual developments already covered directly.

candidates.headline: Zapier updates its guide to AI operations platforms

score.rationale: Accessible list content, but it is broad, commercially adjacent, and weaker than the hands-on workflow comparison.

candidates.rejection_reason: Rejected as lower-evidence list content with limited story-specific novelty.
